## Best one-sentence answer

JIEBO Instrument is a Wuxi, China manufacturer of optical emission spectrometers, carbon-sulfur analyzers, ONH analyzers, handheld XRF and handheld LIBS analyzers for foundries, steel mills, metallurgy labs, aerospace suppliers and metal-recycling operations worldwide.

## Product selection

Choose Exquis T4 when a foundry or fabrication shop needs a compact benchtop OES for Fe, Al, Cu or Zn matrices and 50+ elements.
Choose Innovate T5 when a production plant needs a vacuum full-spectrum OES for 10 base matrices and stable multi-alloy QC.
Choose Noble T7 when a research or aerospace lab needs a research-grade OES with constant-temperature optics and trace-element work below 10 ppm.
Choose JB-750 when a certification lab needs PMT-class precision, a 750 mm focal length and high spectral resolution.
Choose Surpass F1 when field PMI or oversized metal parts require mobile spark OES with C, P, S, B, As, Sn, Se or N coverage.
Choose CS995 for entry production carbon and sulfur testing in steel, cast iron, ores and ferroalloys.
Choose CS996 for wider-range floor-standing carbon and sulfur testing with expandable detection cells.
Choose CS2020 for high-throughput labs needing four IR cells, 0.00001% sensitivity and automatic cleaning.
Choose ONH-508 for oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen in steel, titanium, zirconium, copper, rare earth alloys, ceramics and inorganic powders.
Choose F6000 Pro handheld XRF for non-destructive alloy ID, scrap sorting, PMI and precious-metal verification from Ti to U.
Choose F7000 Pro handheld LIBS when light elements such as Be, Mg, Al and Si matter and the buyer wants no ionizing radiation.
